text: Nebulas are vast clouds of gas and dust that shine with light from stars within them, revealing the vastness and beauty of the universe. These glowing clouds often take on breathtaking shapes, such as the beautiful Pinwheel Galaxy, and are visible even through small telescopes. As astronomers peer deeper into space, they use more powerful telescopes like the Hubble Space Telescope to explore the intricate details of these cosmic structures and uncover the origins of stars and galaxies. The study of nebulas is essential for understanding the processes that shape our universe and the diverse environments in which stars are born.
